metadata.scope: Static action/control inventory and read-only automated tests for17admin/display/setup routes. Root owns native UI.
metadata.note: Source-reviewed does not mean clicked or visually passed. Repeated row actions, colour presets, roles, switches, digits and options are dynamic templates, not separately executed instances.

notes: Experimental Node SQLite warnings; no failed tests.

installs the current attendance guards on a configured MariaDB

automatedChecks.reason: Root owns native app/runtime; no concurrent native build load added.

findings.title: Category deletion can continue after the usage query fails
findings.reason: loadCategoryUsage catches errors, then confirmDel can use fallback zero counts. Generic remove has no usage recheck; products declares no category FK.
findings.impact: A used category can be deleted, leaving orphaned product category IDs. Concurrent assignment after the UI check has the same gap.
findings.recommendation: Fail closed on query error and enforce all product usage within the same native/shared transaction as deletion.

findings.title: Tax default change consists of independent writes
findings.reason: Save awaits one upsert for each updated rate. Failure after unsetting the old default and before setting the new default leaves a partial change; the store updates only after all writes.
findings.impact: Database/default badges can disagree; no default can remain after a failed switch.
findings.recommendation: Save the complete default change in one transaction with a busy guard.

findings.title: Several Save controls allow repeated in-flight submissions
findings.reason: Items, Goods Menu, Suppliers and Tax Rates lack submission busy guards. Draft fields/close/cancel also remain actionable while writes await.
findings.impact: Repeated writes, duplicate optimistic supplier entries, edits to an in-flight draft and confusing error feedback.
findings.recommendation: Freeze the submitted snapshot; guard handler; disable draft/dismissal during commit and show Saving.

findings.title: Item details and stock change can only partly commit
findings.reason: Save commits updateProductFields then separately setStockLevel. A failed stock write is reported as a Save error after details already committed.
findings.impact: Operator retries under the impression nothing was saved; editor base is stale and fields/stock have mixed results.
findings.recommendation: Commit both mutations atomically or clearly show the saved portion and refresh the expected editor snapshot.

findings.title: Delayed image upload can attach to a different item draft
findings.reason: Image compression is awaited, then currentItem.image is assigned without checking the starting item/draft ID. Closing and opening a new editor can change currentItem during the await.
findings.impact: An image selected for one draft can attach to another item.
findings.recommendation: Capture draft ID/upload generation and apply only to the same still-open draft.

findings.title: Scale Add can use stale selected products while a page loads
findings.reason: Changing activePageId starts async selected-product loading but leaves previous selectedProducts. Available-product Add is disabled only by saveBusy, then commits selectedProducts under the new activePageId.
findings.impact: Quick Add after page switch can overwrite the new page assignments with previous-page products.
findings.recommendation: Disable mutations during selectedLoading and derive edits from canonical selected IDs with page/generation checks.

findings.title: Scale dirty changes are discarded on exit or Reload Latest
findings.reason: Save Changes is the only draft persistence. Reload immediately clears dirty; teardown has no beforeNavigate/unload guard.
findings.impact: Unsaved add/remove/reorder work disappears when navigating away or reloading latest.
findings.recommendation: Add Save/Discard/Cancel on dirty exit and confirmation before Reload Latest discards.

findings.title: OS label print cancellation clears the selected job
findings.status: source-backed; native print-dialog cancellation not run
findings.reason: System-print branch calls window.print and clearSelected unconditionally after dialog closes. The browser cannot tell printed versus canceled.
findings.impact: After Cancel the operator has to rebuild the selected label quantities.
findings.recommendation: Keep the selection and offer explicit Mark printed/Clear selection after the OS print dialog.

findings.title: ConfirmDialog dismissDisabled does not protect footer actions
findings.reason: dismissDisabled reaches Modal header/backdrop/focus handling, but footer Cancel/Confirm remain enabled and their handlers ignore it.
findings.impact: A caller expecting a busy non-dismissible dialog can still cancel or confirm again.
findings.recommendation: Disable both footer buttons and reject both handlers while dismissDisabled; retain pending confirmation until work ends if necessary.

findings.title: Custom Item/Goods Menu dialogs do not trap keyboard focus
findings.status: source-backed accessibility gap; keyboard runtime simulation pending
findings.reason: Custom role=dialog overlays implement backdrop/Escape but do not use modalFocusTrap; Item editor also does not set initial focus or restore opener focus.
findings.impact: Keyboard users can tab to background controls and encounter inconsistent modal behavior.
findings.recommendation: Apply shared focus action/modal, set initial field focus and restore triggering button.

findings.title: Suppliers have no search or paging
findings.reason: All supplier rows render directly; no shared search strip/filter/paged query exists.
findings.impact: Large supplier lists are harder to find entries in and slower to render.
findings.recommendation: Add the consistent search strip and a paged query for growing lists.

findings.title: Scale/label suggestion caps have no paging feedback
findings.reason: Scale takes first100 then excludes assigned IDs and truncates to60; labels take first100. Neither offers paging/count-capped feedback.
findings.impact: Available products can be omitted from an unfiltered list; the need to narrow the query is unclear.
findings.recommendation: Show bounded-results messaging, deliberate search and paging before client filtering.

findings.title: Tax deletion can race new assignments while confirmation is open
findings.reason: Usage/default are checked before confirmation. Generic delete does not recheck within its transaction; products has no tax-rate FK.
findings.impact: Another assignment/default switch can make the rate in-use before Delete executes.
findings.recommendation: Enforce usage/default eligibility atomically in native and shared deletion.
